note: Runtime DDL in cloudflare-worker/src that check-runtime-schema-declared.mjs records rather than fails. `refused` lists objects a runtime CREATE names that no migration declares and that SQLite refuses on the fresh build; each entry is re-proved on every run, so the day a refusal stops (a column added, a quote fixed) the entry fails as `refusal-changed` and the object must be declared or its statement deleted. `opaque` counts statements per file that the check cannot expand, each read by hand. The check refuses stale entries in both directions: a ledger of known gaps is only worth reading if every line is still true (D235).
